mapper.select:
select pqa.quotation_id, pqa.quotation_cashflow_id, pqa.times, pqa.calc_date, pqa.due_date,
case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then -pqa.due_amount else pqa.due_amount end due_amount,
pqa.interest, pqa.net_interest, pqa.vat_interest, pqa.principal, pqa.net_principal, pqa.vat_principal, pqa.cf_item, (select h.description from hls_cashflow_item h where h.cf_item = pqa.cf_item)cf_item_n, case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then '流出' else '流入' end cf_direction_n, pqa.cf_direction,
case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then -pqa.net_due_amount else pqa.net_due_amount end net_due_amount,
case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then -pqa.vat_due_amount else pqa.vat_due_amount end vat_due_amount,
pqa.cf_type, pqa.calc_base_amount, pqa.calc_ratio, pqa.deposit_interest_flag, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_interest_flag) deposit_interest_flag_n, pqa.deposit_interest_rate, pqa.days_per_year, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ABS_PRODUCT_STANDAR_DAYS' and scv.value = pqa.days_per_year) days_per_year_n,
pqa.deposit_settle_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'DEPOSIT_SETTLE_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_settle_type) deposit_settle_type_n,
pqa.deposit_settle_date, pqa.deposit_return_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'DEPOSIT_RETURN_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_return_type) deposit_return_type_n, pqa.tax_type_rate, pqa.amortization_method, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'EXP.AMORTIZATION_METHOD' and scv.value = pqa.amortization_method) amortization_method_n, pqa.deposit_return_date,
pqa.calc_base, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'CALC_BASE' and scv.value = pqa.calc_base) calc_base_n,
pqa.receipt_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'RECEIPT_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.receipt_type) receipt_type_n,
pqa.payment_date_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'PAYMENT_DATE_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.payment_date_type) payment_date_type_n,
pqa.stage_type, case pqa.stage_type when '租前期' then 1 when '宽限期' then 2 when '租赁期' then 3 else 4 end stage_type_seq
from quotation_cashflow_history pqa
pqa.quotation_id = #{quotationId}
and pqa.cf_item = #{cfItem}
and pqa.cf_type = #{cfType}
and pqa.cf_type in (5,52,53)
and pqa.cf_type in (3,4,65)
and pqa.cf_item in (1,10)
order by stage_type_seq asc,pqa.due_date asc,pqa.times asc

select pqc.quotation_id, pqc.quotation_cashflow_id, pqc.source_cashflow_id, pqc.due_date, py.due_amount / py.paynote_rate due_amount, py.paynote_rate, py.due_amount paynote_amount, py.paynote_term, py.due_date accepted_date, pqc.paynote_charge_rate, pqc.due_amount paynote_charge_fee, py.net_due_amount, py.vat_due_amount, pqc.cf_item, pqc.cf_type from quotation_cashflow_history pqc left join quotation_cashflow_history py on pqc.source_cashflow_id = py.quotation_cashflow_id where pqc.cf_item = 91 and pqc.quotation_id = #{quotationId}

select pqa.quotation_id, pqa.quotation_cashflow_id, pqa.times, pqa.calc_date, pqa.due_date,
pqa.due_amount,
pqa.interest, pqa.net_interest, pqa.vat_interest, pqa.principal, pqa.net_principal, pqa.vat_principal, pqa.cf_item, (select h.description from hls_cashflow_item h where h.cf_item = pqa.cf_item)cf_item_n, case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then '流出' else '流入' end cf_direction_n, pqa.cf_direction,
case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then pqa.net_due_amount else pqa.net_due_amount end net_due_amount,
case pqa.cf_direction when 'OUTFLOW' then pqa.vat_due_amount else pqa.vat_due_amount end vat_due_amount,
pqa.cf_type, pqa.calc_base_amount, pqa.calc_ratio, pqa.deposit_interest_flag, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_interest_flag) deposit_interest_flag_n, pqa.deposit_interest_rate, pqa.days_per_year, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ABS_PRODUCT_STANDAR_DAYS' and scv.value = pqa.days_per_year) days_per_year_n,
pqa.deposit_settle_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'DEPOSIT_SETTLE_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_settle_type) deposit_settle_type_n,
pqa.deposit_settle_date, pqa.deposit_return_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'DEPOSIT_RETURN_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.deposit_return_type) deposit_return_type_n, pqa.tax_type_rate, pqa.amortization_method, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'EXP.AMORTIZATION_METHOD' and scv.value = pqa.amortization_method) amortization_method_n, pqa.deposit_return_date,
pqa.calc_base, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'CALC_BASE' and scv.value = pqa.calc_base) calc_base_n,
pqa.receipt_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'RECEIPT_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.receipt_type) receipt_type_n,
pqa.payment_date_type, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'PAYMENT_DATE_TYPE' and scv.value = pqa.payment_date_type) payment_date_type_n,
pqa.stage_type, case pqa.stage_type when '租前期' then 1 when '租赁期' then 3 else 2 end stage_type_seq,
(select pay.due_amount from quotation_cashflow_history pay where pay.quotation_cashflow_id = ( select plc.source_cashflow_id from quotation_cashflow_history plc where plc.quotation_id = pqa.quotation_id and plc.cf_item = 91 and plc.due_date = pqa.due_date ))paynote_amount, pqa.base_amount
from quotation_cashflow_history pqa
pqa.quotation_id = #{quotationId} and pqa.cf_item = 0
order by stage_type_seq asc,pqa.times asc
